resources.name: Bonded Senses Rounds
resources.description: Rounds per day equal Spiritualist level; the phantom must be manifested on the same plane.

resources.name: Bonded Manifestation Rounds
resources.description: Rounds per day equal 3 + Spiritualist level, increasing to 3 + twice level with Dual Bond.

resources.name: Phantom Recall
resources.description: One daily use at 6th level plus one additional use per 4 levels beyond 6th.

resources.name: Calm Spirit
resources.description: One daily use at 7th level plus one at 11th, 15th, and 19th level.

choice_providers.label: Phantom Emotional Focus
choice_providers.description: Choose the phantom's emotional focus. It determines the phantom's skills, good saves, ability adjustment, and level-scaled powers.

notes: The Phantom is a full bonded-companion provider with an independently saved sheet; emotional focus and manifestation resources remain attached to the retained Phantom feature.
